text:
emily (AP): Uploading invoice from Sierra Dataworks (INV-SD-77). Total $6,240. No PO field captured. PDF attached.
accounts-bot: New invoice uploaded: INV-SD-77.pdf (vendor id SD-77) - parsed amount $6,240.00 - PO detection: none, OCR hint 'PO: 6600' (LOW_CONF).
noah (Finance Ops): FYI this vendor did a short feature-flagged eval we asked for. @luke can you please hunt for POs? Vendor says reference to PO-6600 in SOW.
luke (Procurement): Searching vendor SD-77 history. We have PO-6600 but it's assigned to Redwood-EMEA (GL 5420) and was closed Q4. There's PO-7721 active for Redwood-US but that's for managed infra, different SOW.
hana (ML Eng): Sierra ran the offline tuning for the recommendations team under ticket REC-314. SOW SD-SOW-12 references PO-6600 though procurement set up that PO under EMEA. Work was contracted by EMEA originally but deliverable was for US product.
emily (AP): Invoice header shows billed to Redwood-US (GL 5403). That mismatch is why autoplace failed.
diane (Eng Manager): I can approve payment from US ledger if procurement or AP needs manager approval. Confirming REC-314 deliverables received.
luke (Procurement): Two ops: A) reassign PO-6600 to US / make it cross-entity (procurement change, takes ~3 business days) or B) process as Non-PO Payment Request (NPR) with Eng Manager approval if vendor terms are short. Invoice due 2026-03-26.
noah (Finance Ops): For speed we usually do NPR if vendor demands payment. What's tax/VAT? OCR captured VAT $240. Vendor master shows VAT registered in Ireland. If paid from US no VAT reclaim.
vendor-bot: Vendor master: SD-77 - Sierra Dataworks Ltd - Tax ID SD-IE-221 - Default remit: EUR IBAN - Default entity: Redwood-EU.
hana (ML Eng): We have an email from vendor confirming USD wire for US work. I'll attach to the payment request.
diane (Eng Manager): Attached and approving. Please charge to REC-314 and include note "Approved Diane - REC-314 (US)".
luke (Procurement): Please create NPR and attach vendor email. I'll also open PROC-4789 to review PO-6600 entity mapping.
emily (AP): NPR created: NPR-9502 routing to diane (approver), procurement, and finance-ops. Link: https://redwood/payments/NPR-9502
accounts-bot: NPR-9502 status: pending approval from diane.
accounts-bot: diane approved NPR-9502 - comment: "Charge REC-314 (US) - expedite to meet vendor Net30."
emily (AP): Scheduling USD wire; marking "subject to tax review" for procurement/tax to check withholding.
luke (Procurement): PROC-4789 created to change PO ownership or set intercompany mapping. ETA 3 business days. Adding vendor USD remit option to vendor master.
vendor-bot: Payment scheduled: NPR-9502 - wire scheduled 2026-03-19 - REF SD-WX-221.
emily (AP): Wire executed. Received remittance confirmation from vendor.
noah (Finance Ops): Follow-up: procurement, please confirm whether an intercompany journal is needed and update PO-6600 to include cross-entity flag. We want to avoid repeated NPRs for same PO mismatch.
luke (Procurement): Will reconcile PROC-4789 and update vendor master. Noted.
hana (ML Eng): Thanks - we'll ensure future SOWs include explicit PO and GL in the invoice reference.
accounts-bot: Thread closed.
